text:
Ava (Head of Product): quick follow-up from today's all-hands on pricing + quotas. drop short Qs here about credits, region quotas, and metering delays and we'll capture for the FAQ.

Leah (Customer Success): customer asked about metering backfill: they ran a large offline embedding job against a private deployment and the usage showed up late. what's the expected window for backfills?

Mike (Billing PM): backfill window for Private/Dedicated depends on the ingest job: typical is within 5-10 minutes, but for very large batches it can take up to 2 hours to reconcile. hosted ingestion is usually <2 minutes. we'll add explicit SLAs in the docs.

Dan (Eng): for Private installs, is there a safe mode to prevent backfill from immediately consuming credits? customer wants to preview cost before commit.

Riley (SRE): we support a preview-only ingest flag in the YAML for Private: `metering: preview: true` which simulates units without debiting. admin must enable preview in the quota policy. we'll document the snippet.

Mike (Billing PM): note: preview mode doesn't reserve capacity. if you actually run the job, it will consume credits at reconciliation time.

Leah (Customer Success): another ask: per-region quotas. customer runs in EU+US and wants separate credit pools per region.

Ava (Head of Product): we support regional buckets for Dedicated/Private via namespace tags. hosted accounts: we currently have a single global pool but can map regional pools for enterprise contracts. reach out to sales/CS for setup.

Dan (Eng): curious: how do SLA credits interact with billing if we have an outage and get a service credit? does that restore consumed credits?

Mike (Billing PM): SLA service credits are applied on the invoice as a dollar credit, not token credits. we don't convert service credits back into token units automatically; we can offer one-off token adjustments case-by-case.

Riley (SRE): propagation note: when you top up credits via Console, writes propagate to Private control plane within ~60s, but regionally there can be a short window where local metering uses the last snapshot. schedule top-ups before big jobs if possible.

Leah (Customer Success): customers also want a quick guide: "How to get an emergency manual lift" during a launch. what's the process?

Mike (Billing PM): emergency manual lifts: for hosted -> Console temporary burst if payment method configured. Dedicated/Private -> CS ticket with launch tag, we can apply a scoped lift within 30-60 minutes depending on verification. Documented in the runbook.

Ava (Head of Product): action items: 1) Mike to write metering/backfill SLA note, 2) Riley to add `metering: preview` YAML snippet to Private docs, 3) Leah to collect customer examples for regional buckets and emergency lifts. We'll merge into FAQ.

Dan (Eng): example YAML for preview mode:
```yaml
metering:
  preview: true
  max_preview_units: 100000
```
(very small sample)

Mike (Billing PM): I'll add a line in the billing FAQ that previews are free but non-reserving. also to confirm: retries after 429s don't consume credits.

Riley (SRE): confirmed. 429-level rejects don't debit. success after retry will. we'll add note to rate-limit page.
